NEW DATE! October 13!
From Focus Features and Working Title comes
an irresistible new take on Jane Austen's iconic
Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and
deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood
starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-
Miles.
Here's what to expect:
• Settle in and read your new copy of Sense
and Sensibility (or bring whatever else you're
currently reading)
• Pause for an exclusive sneak peek at the film
itself, a special movie clip just for our readers
• Write "Letters to a Friend," a short writing
prompt and paired discussion
• Enjoy a themed drink
• Close out the night with bookish
conversations
We'll have 50 copies of the special movie tie-
in book to give away!
We invite you to bring your book bestie! This
event can be fun for a pair! Grab the Book
Bestie ticket and bring your sister or your best
friend with you. It's $40 for the pair, that's a
20% discount for buying together.
